title: 团队批次与交接
thesis: 同一条验收条件随可并行的任务包流转，Lead 和独立评审人分别凭自己的证据接手。
journey: 原文确认 → 活动编排 → 第 1 批派工 → 两项交付与 G3 核验 → G4 独立复核发现 F-24 → EX-17 修复后送回同一评审人 → 新会话复审签收并交给 Lead。源设计、原退回单和交付快照都有反向入口。

pages.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Design the first screen of an original Fouc desktop Chinese team handoff application, a precise full-bleed 1600x960 desktop product screenshot (landscape), no presentation backdrop, no decorative matte. Two real shot frames attached: reference A is Barly Design for Uxerflow's Synchro Board Detail at 12.6s (flat task detail and neutral profile navigation), reference B is its Synchro Dashboard at 10.5s (the comment thread and attachment treatment). Work from the INSIDE of those app windows, preserve the stylistic restraint, font scale, flat white work surface, quiet gray sidebar of about 16% width, charcoal text and black action, spring-like tiny tint only on evidence/selection. The result is Fouc, not a copy of text, brand, data, outer matte or source avatar identity. New precise content: gray left sidebar with Fouc and a black create button, four small task navigation rows, favorites, tiny human account at the base; 48px top bar with real project picker 产品研发, search and actual members. Second band 48px with 按筛选导出任务, right black 确认并交给 Lead. Actual content begins around y=110. Quiet two-column task work surface, roughly 840px authoritative document and 330px compact discussion. Left shows 任务导出设计 with subtle v3 pill, sourced scope, AC-01 and selected AC-02 '导出结果仅含当前筛选命中且本人可见的任务', table of F-18/F-21/F-24 expected visibility, and two restrained linked file objects. Right shows small real-looking Chinese collaborators, an agent and reviewer with ownership. Use restrained exact Chinese type at 13-14 CSS pixels in a real 1600x960 window, normal reference-scale small controls 28px, title no larger than 25px, no oversized headings, pastel cards, photo banners, fake charts, KPI numbers, product marketing, browser chrome, or diagonal perspective. Precisely aligned grid and modest reference-like breathing space; small nearly imperceptible shadows exclusively at controls. Show actual information close to the top rather than a poster. This is one complete product screen.

portraits.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create a single clean 2:1 rectangular studio contact sheet for TWO original fictional collaborator profile photographs, two equally wide square photographs side by side edge-to-edge, vertical boundary dead center. No words, grid outlines, margins, labels, props or icons. Professional candid contemporary Chinese software product team, neutral natural window light, 50mm, short camera distance, tight head-and-shoulders, normal facial proportions not beauty retouch; each face exactly centered horizontally and vertically near 48%, both people facing the viewer warmly, realistic and distinct. LEFT square: Chinese woman age 32, short dark bob tucked behind left ear, taupe work jacket, warm sand studio background.
